headline: Fun-size south swell with the most juice of the region — surfable most of the day.
today: Best spot going with total waves pushing 3ft and a good S angle, even if the period's short. Wind stays cross-on to cross and manageable all day so there's no hard cutoff. Fish or shortboard if you've got punch, work it around the 5:58p high.

daysToWatch.note: The pick of the week — chest-high sets, good angle, and W cross wind staying clean into the evening. Rearrange plans for this one.
Fun leftovers with a glassy light-wind window through the morning before SSW ramps to 16mph in the evening. Dawn to midday is the play.
